necro_intro: Each open page names what it wants. Sacrifice it, then perform the ritual at twilight.
necro_ritual_wait: The ritual can only be performed at twilight.
necro_ritual_nothing: No page has everything it asked for yet.
necro_ritual_guest: Only the gardener who owns this farm can perform the ritual.
necro_footer: Put what a page asks for in your hands and walk up to the book. A chest to the west of the book feeds it for you.
necro_page_crop_blurb: Sacrifice twenty fruit of one crop. The first fruit you give decides which crop that is, and nothing else will do after.
necro_page_early_fruit_blurb: Sacrifice one fruit of each of the six crops a new farm can grow. Any Variety, any Quality.
necro_page_ash_blurb: Sacrifice ash. A furnace makes it out of wood, weeds and spoiled produce.
necro_page_gold_name: Six hundred and sixty-six in coin
necro_page_gold_blurb: Sacrifice money straight out of the farm's account. It buys nothing and it comes back as nothing.
necro_page_agaric_blurb: Sacrifice three Fly agaric. Digging burrows is the only way to find them, and they only turn up in the richest ones.
necro_page_tool_blurb: Sacrifice a Rotary shovel or a Diamond pickaxe, whichever you can spare. One is enough, and it does not come back.
necro_page_supper_blurb: Sacrifice one Barackpálinka, one Premium wine, and one Bread. The spirit is distilled from Klosterneuburger apricots, the wine aged from Kéknyelű grapes.
necro_gold_short: The farm does not have that much.
necro_grandma_ill_body: Her hand is shakier than it was. She writes that the doctor in town has been out twice this week and that she would rather talk about the garden. She asks what you have got in the ground.
necro_grandma_care_body: She has stopped writing herself. A neighbour sends word that she sleeps most of the day now and that someone sits with her through the night. The money she sends has been getting smaller, and you understand why.
necro_grandma_gone_body: She died in the early morning, at home, with the window open. She left you the farm, the seeds in the shed, and a box of papers nobody has opened yet.
necro_grandma_told_body: The box of papers is mostly receipts. Underneath them is a list, in her hand, of things she never bought and one book she never found. A note at the bottom says the book can bring a person back, that it asks for a great deal, and that a farm is the only place that could ever pay it. The husband says he can look into it.
